title: RS7 105 Di2 Australian distributor page
notes: Australian distributor page for the RS7 105 Di2 at AUD 3,999 RRP; online ordering was not yet available. Its FAQ states clearance for up to 32c tires, a 110 kg limit including rider and gear, no fender or rack compatibility, no UDH (an RS7-specific hanger), compatibility with most mechanical, wired and wireless groupsets except full-mount rear derailleurs, up to 52/36T Shimano or 56/43T SRAM double or 66T single chainrings, a dual-sided power meter, and tubeless-compatible rims fitted with non-tubeless tires. Its component table conflicts with the international page: it lists an XDS T700 carbon frame, mechanical 105 shifting parts for this Di2 product and Branta R332 700×32C tires, and states 8.49 kg.
